0022600145.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-4, 0-2 on the road) have lost four straight and sit 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 3 games back, while the New Orleans Pelicans (0-3) are also winless, have dropped three in a row, and sit 14th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, 3.5 games back. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Kings lost the 2025-26 series 1-2 and won the most recent meeting 117-113 in Sacramento on April 3, 2026. The Kings are without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and the Pelicans are without Yves Missi (knee, bruise).
